adapterRollbackAdjudicator.businessSignal: Rollback is represented as a reviewer ruling over dry-run rollback previews, not as an automatic production rollback command.

receiptDisputeReplay.businessSignal: Public evidence claims can be replayed, resolved, or counterclaimed while private receipt bodies remain outside the package.

auditExportDiff.businessSignal: Export schema changes are made explicit as added, changed, or unchanged rows with private fields still redacted.

guardrails: Rollback adjudication can approve only dry-run rollback previews.
Receipt dispute replay cannot expose private owner receipt bodies.
Audit export diff must keep privateFieldsExposed at zero.
Any private value exposure or non-zero live write blocks the package.
